sedationAdvancedCeNote: Ce derived from {{source}} (ke0 = {{ke0}}/min). Exploratory PKPD — not for clinical dosing decisions.
sedationCeUnavailableReason: Effect-site model not implemented for this drug — PD endpoints (analgesia, sedation, dissociation, EEG, hemodynamics) have endpoint-specific concentration-effect relationships and no single ke0 captures all clinical effects.
dexContextWarning: Dexmedetomidine sedation is highly context-dependent — arousal, stimulation, co-administered drugs, age, hepatic/cardiac function, and ICU illness substantially alter the clinical effect.
ketamineContextWarning: S-ketamine PK only (Noppers 2011) — racemic ketamine is not modelled; do not interpret these concentrations as total racemic ketamine. Ce intentionally not shown — see Ce N/A note for why.
ketamineHeatPainRef: Heat-pain C50 ~375 ng/mL (Sigtermans/Noppers, experimental — not a sedation/anesthesia threshold)
burdenTooltip: Opioid burden = cumulative opioid exposure over time. Total AUC is the area under the effect-site concentration curve (∫Ce dt). Therapeutic AUC counts exposure within the analgesic band; Supratherapeutic is the area above the upper analgesic threshold. The right-axis dashed curve shows the **instantaneous** respiratory-risk index Σ(Ce/RespC50) — a different concept from AUC. Both are shown so you can read live risk and cumulative load at the same time.
xAxisMinTooltip: X-axis lower bound (minutes from sim start)
resetDisplayTooltip: Reset axes / time-zero / display modes to defaults (events and patient unchanged)
viewLiteratureTooltip: Show literature references for this drug's therapeutic range
noReferenceData: No literature reference data available for this drug.
provisionalWarning: Some Ce values for this drug are extrapolated or inferred — primary literature with abstract-level Ce50 was not located. Treat numeric ranges as guidance, not precision.
